description: This Java class 'LogWrapper' defines a wrapper around Android's native Log utility, implementing the LogNode interface, to facilitate logging with chaining capabilities. It allows logging messages with different priorities and handles exceptions, optionally passing log data to the next node in the chain.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for Android's log utility implementing the LogNode interface, allowing chaining of log nodes.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to receive log data.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs the message with specified priority, tag, and optional exception. Passes log data to the next node if present.
